paragraphs.text: Adriana Vallore is a knight from Fiora .

Adriana was the Captain of the Guard under King Brago . She took his sword after his death and quit her job on the day of Queen Marchesa 's coronation. Inspired by Kaya 's parting words, she plotted to overthrow the monarchy of Paliano and build a republic with Selvala as the figurehead.
Adriana's city guard was thrown over in favor of troops loyal only to Marchesa, and many were imprisoned. Adriana staged some daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side.
